title: Morphological Matching Transforms & Text Token Splitting Architecture

blocks.content: Engineering notebook from `docs/MORPHOLOGICAL_MATCHING_AND_TEXT_SPLITTER_ARCHITECTURE.md`. This archive preserves the project’s original rationale, equations, performance reports and illustrative code. Historical paths, API names, claims and sketches can differ from the current engine. For copy-ready programs use the guides and demos; for current callable signatures use the source-derived API. Performance figures here describe reported experiments, not guaranteed frame rates.

blocks.text: Original document: [docs/MORPHOLOGICAL_MATCHING_AND_TEXT_SPLITTER_ARCHITECTURE.md](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/docs/MORPHOLOGICAL_MATCHING_AND_TEXT_SPLITTER_ARCHITECTURE.md). See [current limitations](/limitations) for concrete compatibility notes.

Transforming mathematical formulas (such as simplifying $(a + b)^2 \to a^2 + 2ab + b^2$) or transitioning complex typographic sentences requires aligning identical elements while morphing or fading altered symbols.

items: **[`TransformMatchingTex`](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/animation/transform/TransformMatchingTex.ts)**: AST-aware LaTeX formula transition that pairs matching mathematical symbols (variables, exponents, operators), sliding them to new coordinates and morphing altered terms.

**[`TransformMatchingText`](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/animation/transform/TransformMatchingText.ts)**: Word- and letter-level alignment for natural language text transitions.

**[`TransformMatchingShapes`](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/animation/transform/TransformMatchingShapes.ts)**: Bipartite matching engine pairing geometric contours between arbitrary multi-path vector shapes.

**[`TextSplitter`](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/entities/composites/text/TextSplitter.ts)**: Algorithmic utility decomposing text entities into character, word, regex, or custom index sub-entities while preserving spatial kerning and layout metrics.

blocks.text: The example matches $\int_0^1 x^2\,dx = \frac{1}{3}$ with $\int_0^1 x^3\,dx = \frac{1}{4}$. Shared symbols keep their identity while changed terms morph or fade.

items: Both formulas are decomposed into individual glyph paths via `source.decompose()` and `target.decompose()`.
Each glyph's identity key is resolved via MathJax SVG identifiers:

blocks.text: Identical symbols (e.g. variable $x$, plus sign $+$, equal sign $=$) share identical keys.
Each glyph exists inside a nested transformed coordinate hierarchy. `TransformMatchingTex` walks up the parent chain:
This enables glyphs to transition seamlessly between formulas with different font sizes, line alignments, or parent groups.

items: **Matched Glyphs**: An animated translation vector moves the source symbol smoothly to the target coordinates using [`StateAnimation`](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/animation/StateAnimation.ts).

children: If `morphUnmatched: true` (default), unmatched terms smoothly morph into the corresponding target glyph via [`VectorTransform`](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/animation/transform/VectorTransform.ts).
If `morphUnmatched: false`, old terms fade out while new terms fade in simultaneously.

blocks.text: `TextSplitter` breaks monolithic text entities into animatable sub-entities:

items: **Character-Level (`separator: ''`)**: Decomposes text into individual glyph entities for typewriter, scatter, and wave animations.
**Word-Level (`separator: ' '`)**: Groups characters into words, preserving whitespace metrics.
**Regex Matches (`separator: /[A-Z]+/g`)**: Groups tokens matching arbitrary grammatical patterns.
**Explicit Ranges (`separator: [[0, 4], [5, 10]]`)**: Decomposes text into explicit user-defined substrings.

When `replace: true`, the original parent is detached from the scene and replaced with a [`VGroup`](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/entities/layout/VGroup.ts) of child tokens without any visual jump or reflow.
